svg.aria-label: Three distinct screening limitations with denominators and observed data
svg.text: Finite wind screening: three different limits to inference
158 m DTU 10 MW hybrid-tower archive · distinct denominators, not interchangeable failure probabilities
93.30% unmatched (99,736 h): fourth moment not upper-bounded without assumptions
B · Conditional controlling-bin changes (observed seed subsets)
Not 8,000 independent turbulence experiments; no future-event probability
C · Exponent-transfer screening failure (fixed-design ETM sections)
m=4-selected case misses 10.60–15.36% of m=10 envelope
Sources: archived T062 18 NTM runs / ERA5 exposure, 8,000 subset enumeration, and T077 four-ETM × 31-section nominal-stress table.
Inference boundary: load screening only; no material-local Miner damage, full DLC1.2, independent-seed reliability, or coupled W/E/WE.
Figure S12-1 · Evidence visualization, not a new physical simulation or statistical confidence interval.
